'''Moss giants''' are large [[Giant (race)|giants]], found in areas that are tied to nature. Moss giants are very commonly trained on, since their [[Defence]] level is rather low in comparison to other monsters of the same [[combat level]], and they are vulnerable to [[Fire spells]].

They can drop the [[mossy key]], which is required to access the moss giant boss [[Bryophyta]]'s lair for the first time, and loot [[Chest (Bryophyta's lair)|her chest]] thereafter.

Stronger level 84 [[Moss Giant (Iorwerth Dungeon)|Moss Giants]] can be found in the [[Iorwerth Dungeon]].
